title: Chat/set create loop acquires store lock per entry, not per request
description: ChatSetHandler acquires and drops the Mutex<Store> inside the for-loop over create entries. All other handlers acquire once per method call. The per-entry acquire-release creates an implicit invariant: each entry sees a potentially-different state of the store (state could advance between entries in a multi-create call). The loop should hold one lock for all entries, or the per-entry semantic should be documented explicitly.
